description: Selective robe proportion and arm corrections, transparent background cleanup and reviewed Ice Armor boot attachments. Faces and character identity retained.

params.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this EMPTY fantasy mage costume game asset. Keep its purple cloth, blue shoulder shawl, pale silver runic embroidery, dark sash, thick painted outlines, and the complete closed lower robe hem. Repair the two sleeves: make each sleeve hang naturally at its side, with readable elbow and forearm lengths, then add a small relaxed closed HAND INSIDE AN OPAQUE DARK-PURPLE LEATHER GLOVE emerging visibly from each sleeve opening. Both gloves must be fully visible with clear thumbs and fingers, attached naturally at the wrists; not cut off, not flattened, not oversized. Hands end just above the finished robe hem. Keep balanced compact fantasy RPG costume proportions, not a long robe and not squashed vertically. Match the exact painted shading/material style of the input. This is an empty headless costume sprite with gloves, no person, no face, no neck, no skin, no legs, no feet, no boots, no weapon. Single front-facing outfit, arms at sides. Transparent RGBA background, no black or white backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no glow. Preserve all other clothing details as closely as possible.
